title: Heptabase Updates - Invite Free Users to Collaborate, PDF Enhancements, and more!
summary: Heptabase Updates - Invite Free Users to Collaborate, PDF Enhancements, and more!
body_markdown:
Dear Heptabase User,


We're excited to announce that Heptabase's first collaboration feature is now live after several months of development! You can invite anyone to collaborate on your whiteboard, even non-subscribers can join and edit for free. For more details, see our[Collaboration Q&A](https://support.heptabase.com/en/articles/10510497) .


If you've been using it with your collaborators, we'd love to hear your feedback and suggestions through our[in-app support](https://support.heptabase.com/en/articles/10448156-how-can-i-contact-heptabase-support) .


---


### PDF - Support Google Scholar Preview on Citations​


In the latest version, we've made some quality-of-life improvements to our PDF reading experience, including:


- Support for Google Scholar preview on citations.
- Support using ArrowLeft/Right to navigate the previous/next pdf page.
- Support table of contents on the right sidebar for pdf card tabs.
- Support shift+enter to go previous item in pdf search dialog.
- Memorize the zoom value in pdf card tabs and improve the zooming experience of trackpad.
- Support automatically parsing academic paper (with arXiv or DOI number) titles when uploading pdf files.


---


### New Landing Page and New Help Center​


In addition to the new features, we have recently refined our[landing page](https://heptabase.com/) and migrated our help docs from the public wiki to the new[help center](https://support.heptabase.com/) . You can now directly view and search help center content through the in-app support chat box!


---


We hope that these updates will improve your experience on Heptabase and make your learning easier and more enjoyable.


If you have any feedback or suggestions, or you want to share your use cases or contents related to Heptabase, please don't hesitate to chat with us through our[in app support](https://support.heptabase.com/en/articles/10448156-how-can-i-contact-heptabase-support) .


Stay tuned for future updates, and we hope you have a great day!


Best regards,


Heptabase Team
